lines.en: Black fur traps heat, so I keep to shade.

lines.zh: 我踩过苔藓，几乎没有声
lines.en: I cross the moss almost without a sound.
The trees in this dark forest grow too dense.
I climb this tree to check the way.
My claws hook the bark and I climb.
There is a gap in the bushes I can squeeze through.
I circle the beehive once.
The creek stones are slick, so I slow down.

lines.zh: 我的毛色在暗处看不见
lines.en: In the shadows my black coat disappears.
I follow the ridge down toward lower ground.
That deer ran the moment it saw me.
My belly drags through the tall grass.

lines.zh: 树根拱起来，绊了我一下
lines.en: A root humped up and tripped me.
I turn back, the wind has shifted.

lines.zh: 我顺着溪水往下走，好认路
lines.en: I follow the stream downhill to keep my bearings.

lines.zh: 秋天的林子，我走得更慢
lines.en: In the autumn woods I walk slower.

lines.zh: 浆果丛红了一片，真扎眼
lines.en: The berry patch has gone bright red.
I sit under the tree and lick my paw.
My claw marks are scored into the bark.
Bees circle the hive, I keep away.
My fur is thick enough to shed rain.
This fallen log makes a good headrest.
I yawn, and my teeth are blunt.
The woods smell of mushrooms.
I count the fruit up in the branches.
Mud is packed between my claws.
My nose is wet, and it reads everything.

lines.zh: 有只啄木鸟在我头顶敲
lines.en: A woodpecker is drumming above my head.
I rub my back against the trunk.
No one has come to these woods today.

lines.zh: 我在树根下刨出个浅坑
lines.en: I scrape a shallow pit by the roots.

lines.zh: 雪落在背上，我不觉得冷
lines.en: Snow settles on my back. I do not feel it.
You are dressed too bright to hide.

lines.zh: 我闻到你袋子里的浆果
lines.en: I smell berries in your bag.
You hold still, and so do I.
You do not smell of gunpowder.
I watch your hands, not your face.

lines.zh: 你退后两步，我们好说话
lines.en: Two steps back and we can talk.
My eyes shine in the dark.
Do not mimic a bear, you sound wrong.
You stepped on my marking.
I lift my head, and you step back.
Lower your lantern a little.
My memory is poor, but I recall you.
Who dares to touch my coat?
My hide is thick, but that one hurt.
I turn around to see who it was.
That blow landed on my ribs.
A tuft of my fur got torn out.
I back behind a tree and lower my growl.
Do not chase me, I can still fight.
I lift the leg that got hurt.
I will follow your scent to find you.
My breathing is getting heavier.
The lid on that honey jar is loose.
Blueberries spilled everywhere, who did that?

lines.zh: 你手里的果子还在滴水
lines.en: The fruit in your hand is still dripping.
The sweet smell rides the wind to me.
I push my nose up to your palm.
Do not shake, I am not going to bite.
This jar is too smooth for my paws.

lines.zh: 浆果在篮子里滚来滚去
lines.en: Berries roll around inside your basket.
One lick, and the sweetness makes me dizzy.
Leave me half, and I will go.
Honey stuck in my fur and matted it.
I pin the jar down and lick it.

lines.zh: 这味道跟我藏的不一样
lines.en: This tastes different from what I stored.
One step closer and I guard my food.
Whatever is in that bucket smells like fish.

lines.zh: 你把篮子放下，我就过去
lines.en: Set the basket down and I will come over.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，自己先吓一跳
lines.en: You bumped me and frightened yourself.
My coat is thick, that bump did not hurt.

lines.zh: 你的靴子压住了我的尾巴
lines.en: Your boot is resting on my tail.
We collided, and both of us backed off.
I turned aside, yet you still squeezed past.
My shoulder knocked your basket crooked.
You are too close, so I growl low.
We knocked a whole branch of fruit down.
Do not touch me from behind.

lines.zh: 这一撞把我的浆果撒了
lines.en: That bump scattered all my berries.
I followed a scent for three days.
Her coat is blacker and glossier than mine.
I rub against the trunk again and again.
We look at each other across the creek.
I pile berries in front of her.
She sniffed them and did not leave.
This hollow is roomy enough for two cubs.
I lined the den mouth with dry moss.
Another male circles in the distance.
She fell asleep first, so I keep watch.

lines.zh: 我用爪子拨了拨那东西
lines.en: I nudged the thing with my paw.
This branch could be dragged to my den.
I hold the fruit in my mouth.
The stone is too heavy to lift.
This pelt is not one I shed.
I sniffed it once and set it down.
Biting iron makes my teeth ache.
I stuff it into the tree hollow.
My paws are clumsy, I dropped it twice.
I take the hive along with its branch.
That wolf is digging through my berries.
Someone is chopping the tree I claw.
A cat is watching me from the tree.
One of my cubs just called out.
That one is far too close to the hive.
Who has been at my tree hollow?
Torchlight is flickering in my eyes.
My pelt is in your basket.
Those bushes are shaking the wrong way.

lines.zh: 有东西跟着我走了半里
lines.en: Something has trailed me for half a mile.
I lower my head and move in slowly.
I circle downwind to catch its scent.
It retreats, so I edge forward.
A tree blocks it, so I take another path.
My claws tighten against the ground.
I stand half a head taller than it.
When it moves, I hold still.
The wind carries its scent to me.
The den is behind me, no rush.

lines.zh: 我再吼一次，它就明白了
lines.en: One more growl and it will understand.
One sweep of my paw and it tumbled.
My claws caught in its hide.
I press down and it cannot move.
This bite landed on its shoulder.
My forepaw is heavier than a stone.
It backed three steps and still wants to run.
I twist and throw it into the brush.
I held back some strength in that blow.

lines.zh: 我的吼声先到，爪子后到
lines.en: My growl arrives first, my claws after.
It climbs to escape, and I follow.

lines.zh: 我从黑森林的阴影里出来
lines.en: I step out of the dark forest shade.
The trees here are thick enough to claw.
I shake the pine needles off my back.
This stretch of forest answers to me.
The moss at my den is still fresh.
The berries need two months to ripen.
I smell the coming rain.
My prints are pressed into the mud.
This slope faces north and stays cooler.
I walk slowly deeper into the trees.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的毛，焦味刺鼻
lines.en: Fire caught my fur and the smell stings.
I fell into thorns that pricked my back.
Too deep, I thrash my way to the bank.
The blast knocked me flat on the ground.
An arrow buried itself in my thick fur.
A flash of light raised my fur.
The berry season passed and I grew thin.
Lightning split the crown of that tree.

lines.zh: 脚下没了树根，我往下坠
lines.en: The roots are gone, and I am falling.
